doctor.headline: playable, 3 warnings
findings: Wenna Cole is in "The First Floor room 2", which nobody has written yet. The room realizes when somebody walks in, and its description is written without knowing she is there
this story has no arc, so no playthrough of it can ever reach an ending: there is no quest for a beat to belong to and no outcome to select. A world file's `quests:` block is where one is written
"The Landing" has no layout: nobody can be given a spot in it, so what is within reach there cannot be measured
